resources.string: The assistant is not available in this build. Start checks overlay access and screen-sharing consent only. No screen is captured and no floating overlay is shown.
Stopped. Press Start to check permissions. Each screen-sharing check asks for fresh consent.
Allow display over other apps in Android settings, then return and press Start again.
Overlay access was not granted or was revoked. You can retry with Start. Nothing is running.
Waiting for your screen-sharing choice. Nothing is being captured.
Screen sharing was declined. You can retry with Start. Nothing is running.
Screen-sharing consent confirmed and discarded. The assistant is not available yet; nothing is running.
Android could not open the permission screen. Nothing is running. You can retry with Start.

Assistant settings will be added as features become available.\n\nDiagnostics record only event names and permission states in local Android logs. Screen content, consent tokens and personal data are never logged.
